content_text: If you are even mildly skeptical of AI functionality / adoption beyond coding, watch this webinar which features an Apollo employee describing how she uses Claude. https://www.anthropic.com/webinars/claude-for-investing-teams Then take a walk and think about: -Are AI capabilities today ahead of or behind widespread, practical use cases? -Do these use cases seem high ROI for the end-customer? -What inning of adoption do you think we are in?
